description: Turn a raster picture (painting, illustration, portrait, poster) into a layered, animated vector SVG drawn in a style: cel color blocks, line engraving, woodcut, or whatever the reference speaks, with depth planes that part and move. Works the way a painter does, coarse to fine, judging the whole frame by eye at every stage. Use when making a portrait or scene into animatable SVG, rendering a picture in a style, adding motion, parallax, or a separation view to a layered SVG, or reworking a portrait piece, even if the user never says "skill".
